title: HILglebone sensor manifest (v1)
description: Machine-readable schema for HILglebone sensor manifests. Validates a manifest's identity and its user-tunable parameters; the wire layout lives in config-idl (a parameter names the IDL field it drives via `field`). See docs/backend/sensors/manifest-schema.md and config-idl.md. Cross-field rules JSON Schema can't express (default within range, enum default in values, each `field` resolving to a `user` field of the sensor's config-idl) are enforced by the import-time code validator.

schema_version.description: Which schema revision this manifest targets.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Primary key; never change after import.

version.description: Monotonic revision; bump on any breaking change.

description.description: Optional long-form description; rendered as help copy.

protocol.description: Wire protocol; from the ProtocolId proto enum minus the PROTOCOL_ID_ prefix (the STM32 mirrors these as PROTO_ID_*, same values). The UNSPECIFIED/NONE (0) sentinel is excluded — a manifest must name a real protocol.

parameters.description: Typed user-tunable knobs (number/enum/boolean), for protocols whose user inputs are scalars (PWM, DAC, ...). I2C sensors express user-settable values through `registers` marked `user: true` instead.

registers.description: I2C register map — sensor-specific; defines the simulated device. Each register's default byte, plus any `user: true` overrides, compiles to the CMD_SETUP_SENSOR preset block.

allOf.comment: Streaming (reg_addr_width 0) registers are address-less; addressed (1/2) registers require addr.

paramName.description: snake_case, unique within the parameters array of a manifest.

fieldRef.description: Name of the config-idl `user` field this parameter drives (e.g. `freq_hz`). The config-idl owns the wire encoding (offset/width/scale); the manifest only names which field it feeds. Cross-checked against the IDL at import time.

i2cConfig.description: I2C sensor-layer characteristics (sensor semantics). NOTE: clock_hz is a single rated value today; the clock_min_hz/clock_max_hz split is deferred.

clock_hz.description: Rated I2C bus clock (Hz). For now this MUST equal the STM32 I2C slave maximum (F401 Fast-mode = 400000, firmware I2C_SENSOR_CLOCK_MAX_HZ): we only onboard sensors whose rated frequency matches the board's, so the passive out-of-spec handling suffices. Sensors rated below the board max need active clock enforcement, which is deferred. When the board capability map + import validator land, replace this hard-coded const with a check against the target rig's I2C max.

addresses.description: Strap-selectable address(es); the session picks which this instance uses. Entry 1 = primary, entry 2 = secondary. The import validator checks each fits address_mode.

reg_addr_width.description: Register-address width in bytes: 0 = none (streaming sensor — the DUT reads bytes with no register offset), 1 = 8-bit, 2 = 16-bit. Matches firmware I2C_REG_ADDR_WIDTH_NONE/8/16.

response_delay_us.description: Optional pre-data stretch after address match, µs.

clock_stretch_max_us.description: Optional upper bound on clock stretching, µs. 0 = none.

i2cFlags.description: I2C behaviour flags — packed to the firmware u8 `flags` bitfield (bit 7 reserved, always 0). All default false.

pec_required.description: Require PEC on SMBus block transactions; only meaningful with smbus_mode (bit 2).

auto_inc_wrap.description: Auto-increment wraps at register_count-1; else it saturates (bit 3).

dut_writes_allowed.description: Accept DUT register writes and update the map; else NACK them (bit 4).

internal_pullups.description: Enable STM32 internal SDA/SCL pull-ups — lab only, too weak for reliable fast-mode (bit 5).

clock_stretch_enable.description: Allow clock stretching at all; 0 forces instantaneous responses, overriding response_delay_us / clock_stretch_max_us (bit 6).

register.description: One 8-bit register/stream byte. `addr` is required when reg_addr_width is 1 or 2 (addressed) and forbidden when it is 0 (streaming — array order is the stream order); this is enforced by the reg_addr_width conditional. Multi-byte quantities are consecutive entries. The import validator checks addr fits reg_addr_width and addresses are unique.

default.description: Byte value the sensor holds at reset.

user.description: If true, the session can override this register at runtime (flows through the preset mechanism). Default false.

label.description: UI label shown when the register is user-settable.

digitalOutConfig.description: Digital-output sensor-layer electrical characteristics (sensor semantics). Named values map to fixed firmware/GPIO encodings at import time.

spiSlaveConfig.description: SPI-slave sensor-layer characteristics (sensor semantics). The STM32 emulates the slave; the DUT is the master and drives SCK.

spi_mode.description: SPI mode 0-3 (CPOL/CPHA); must match the DUT master.

default_response.description: Optional default bytes the slave returns until the session overrides them via CMD_SET_OUTPUT.

ui.description: Optional overrides to the type-driven UI defaults. Reach for these rarely.

parameter.description: Discriminated on `type`. Exactly one of number / enum / boolean.

values.description: Map from each allowed value name (snake_case) to its wire integer. This value→int mapping is sensor semantics and stays in the manifest; the config-idl `field` owns the byte width/offset.
